a: Functional groups like OH, COOH, NH2 define organic reactivity.
Alkanes are single-bonded; alkenes have C=C double bonds.
Benzene is a classic aromatic ring structure.
Isomers share formula but differ in structure or arrangement.
Polymers are long chains of repeating monomer units.
Amino acids are building blocks of proteins.
Carbohydrates are sugars and polymers like starch and cellulose.
Lipids include fats and oils; often hydrophobic.
Enzymes typically catalyze specific substrates and reactions.
Each pH unit is a tenfold change in [H+].
